title: The payer's portal contact sees the invoice and can pay it
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Use a shop that uses the customer portal.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, the customer the work is for, with contact A1, who can sign in to the customer portal.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer B, the payer, with contact B1, who can sign in to the customer portal.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, invoiced for $150.00, unpaid, billed to customer B.
custom_steps:
1. Sign in to the customer portal as contact B1.
  2. Open work order 1's invoice.
  3. Click Pay.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Contact B1, customer B's contact, is signed in.

Step 2:

  • The $150.00 invoice for work order 1, customer A's work, shows.
  • It has a Pay button.

Step 3:

  • The payment form for $150.00 opens.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)
